scope: Deterministic R2 episode-step/reward/credit ownership and bounded commit fault tests; no model training, policy-performance comparison, held-out evaluation or deployment
reward: Original3*distance_progress-.015+40*collection-30*collision-10*first_assistance. World truth only for reward/outcomes, not actor vectors.
duration_credit: Every original100ms plant step is accounted. Null new requests are not relabeled as STOP; reward accumulates under the actual preceding request with gamma^duration. A leading passive prefix has explicit unattributed reward, never a fabricated action. One-step learner conversion rejects duration>1.
current_learning_compatibility_limit: Frozen learner currently accepts only100ms one-step records. Multi-step credit is recorded correctly but NOT yet trainable by it. Duration-aware learner/discount preflight required before training that includes request gaps; never discard, split or retime such rewards.
preserved: 400ms original request lifetime and0/300/600ms ACTUATOR transport delay, separate from model-inference wait
Natural STOP/assistance collision and full-timeout outcome accounting
New epoch clears history, not physical tails or rewards

test_recipe.geometry: Center/no obstacles plus analytical four-step bank-drift collision fixtures. Generated R2 current/noise/dropouts/gains retained; only position/target/obstacles/actuator-delay fixture fields changed. Not a collision-rate benchmark.
test_recipe.plant_step_budget: Three ten-step snapshot-equivalence checks, five authority steps, two natural four-step drift collisions, three wait-credit steps, two reply-cancel steps; no learning/model performance measurement.
node_checks: Exact full snapshot equality to bare R2 at all three actuator delays
Manual/disarm/cancel memory boundaries with consecutive records
Actual collision after STOP with zero applied command
First assistance charged once and later collision retained
Discounted duration credit and raw reward/step conservation
Rejected reply never causes a new or restamped request
Prepared data ownership and no operator action
Bounded original bridge examples for Python schema validation
python_checks: Real-bridge one-step packets accepted by frozen learner without relabeling
Two verified retained generations with bounded orphan budget
Controlled interruption after checkpoint/generation/before pointer restores old complete learner
Controlled interruption after pointer restores new complete learner/result
Exact learner RNG/replay/Adam restoration using bounded synthetic unit gradients
No skipped seed, censored outcome, pending tail or nonfinite result
test_recipe.commit_limit: At most8generation directories and4pointer-pending files; two committed generations retained. Prune only previous committed hash-verified known files within resolved owned root, no recursive deletion. Orphans preserved for review.
test_recipe.crash_scope: Controlled Python exceptions at transaction boundaries, not arbitrary hard-kill or power-loss durability. A surviving process lock requires owner/process inspection before recovery; not silently removed.
test_recipe.unit_optimizer_limit: At most8synthetic optimizer updates in commit tests; not dataset/plant training. Temporary checkpoint cleanup target is resolved and verified inside workspace/work before recursive cleanup.
